name: Ollama
description: Runs open-weight language models locally on your own machine, with a single command per model and an HTTP API that mimics the common chat-completions shape.
useCase: Running an AI model offline, with no per-token cost and no data leaving your machine.

name: n8n
description: Workflow automation with a visual node editor, several hundred integrations, and the option to self-host. Handles branching, loops and custom code steps that simpler tools cannot.
useCase: Connecting apps and running multi-step automations on a schedule or a webhook.
pricing: Self-hosted community edition free; cloud plans paid — check current pricing

name: Claude Code
description: Anthropic's command-line coding agent. Reads a repository, edits files, runs commands and iterates on test failures from the terminal.
useCase: Delegating multi-file code changes and investigations in an existing codebase.
pricing: Requires a paid Claude plan or API credit — check current pricing

name: Visual Studio Code
description: Microsoft's extensible code editor, with an extension marketplace, integrated terminal, Git support and remote development over SSH and containers.
useCase: Everyday code and config editing, including remote machines.

name: pandas
description: The standard Python library for tabular data — reading messy CSV and Excel files, cleaning columns, reshaping, grouping and exporting the result.
useCase: Cleaning and reshaping spreadsheet data in a repeatable script instead of by hand.

name: Microsoft Power BI
description: Business intelligence suite for building dashboards from multiple data sources. Power BI Desktop authors reports on Windows; sharing them with others requires a paid service tier.
useCase: Building and publishing interactive business dashboards.
pricing: Desktop free; sharing requires a paid tier — check current pricing

name: Looker Studio
description: Google's browser-based reporting tool. Connects to Google Sheets, BigQuery and many third-party sources, and shares dashboards by link.
useCase: Free shareable dashboards, especially over data already in Google Sheets.
pricing: Free tier available; Looker Studio Pro paid — check current pricing

name: GitHub Actions
description: CI/CD runners built into GitHub repositories. Runs workflows on push, pull request, a schedule, or a manual trigger.
useCase: Scheduled jobs and build/deploy pipelines without hosting a server.
pricing: Free minutes on public repos; private metered — check current pricing

name: Astro
description: Static site framework that ships zero JavaScript by default, with Markdown content collections, schema validation and build-time syntax highlighting.
useCase: Content-heavy sites that need to be fast and indexable.
